item.title: Whole House Generator vs. Portable: Real Cost Comparison
item.description:
Disclosure: Some links in this article are affiliate links. If you buy through them, we may earn a small commission at no extra cost to you. This never affects our recommendations — see our affiliate disclosure.

Quick Answer

A whole-house generator costs $5,000-15,000 installed but adds $5,000-10,000 to your home’s resale value, while portable generators cost $500-2,500 but only power essential circuits. Whole-house generators typically cost $500-1,000 per year in maintenance.
